requirements.text: Empower students to manage library transactions independently through self-service capabilities.
Streamline online booking processes for study rooms, allowing easy selection of date, time, and capacity.
Automate fine calculations and send reminders to students regarding due dates.
Provide staff with effective tools for inventory management and generating usage reports.
Ensure integration with the university’s student record system for verification of enrolment status.
Real-time catalogue search with filtering options for criteria such as subject, author, or publication date.
Enable online borrowing and renewing of items, including viewing current loans and due dates.
Allow online returns with immediate confirmation of processed returns.
Provide access to reservation history for tracking past loans and fines.
Send automated notifications and reminders for upcoming due dates.
Create a user-friendly interface for the online booking process of study rooms.
Allow date and time selection with filtering options for room capacity in the booking process.
Provide real-time availability of study rooms to prevent double bookings.
Send immediate booking confirmation via email or system notification.
Allow cancellation and modification options for booked study rooms.
Set usage limits on study room bookings to ensure fair access.
Include accessibility features in the booking process for all students.
Automate fine calculation based on a configurable daily rate for different item types.
Set thresholds for account restrictions based on outstanding fines.
Send automated email notifications when fines are applied.
Provide access to fine history for students to view outstanding fines and payment history.
Enable online payment processing for students to pay their fines.
Generate reports on fine revenue and trends for staff.
Allow staff to easily add and update items in the catalogue.
Provide a simple process for retiring items from the catalogue.
Include bulk operation capabilities for adding and updating multiple items.
Facilitate inventory audits to maintain accurate records.
Provide robust search and filtering capabilities for staff to locate items quickly.
Generate usage reports for loan volumes and borrowing trends.
Integrate inventory management features with borrowing and return processes for real-time status updates.
Automatically verify students' enrolment status before allowing borrowing or booking.
Enable real-time data synchronization between the library and student record systems.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations such as GDPR.
Implement access control measures to restrict student data access to authorized staff only.
Provide audit trails for actions involving student data.
Manage user consent for data processing, informing students about data collection.
Include robust error handling mechanisms for data exchange issues.
